# Martin Krasser

> Freelance AI engineer and architect. Freelance AI engineer and architect with a proven track-record in agentic systems, machine learning, distributed systems, and system integration. 20+ years of experience in architecting, developing and operating production software systems at scale. Extensive industry experience in both technical and leadership roles. Active open source contributor.
